verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right with a one-line headline and a strong CTA, but the CTA is jammed almost against the right canvas edge, the subcopy is tiny (~9px), and the full-bleed lime panel drops the original's floating-card framing. B keeps the floating panel but breaks the headline into two lines, squeezes the subcopy into a cramped three-line column of near-illegible text between the headline and CTA, crowds the badge into the box and the left edge, and pushes the panel's contents into narrow cells with no breathing room.
